title: 连接 BiuBiu工坊
description: 填写你在 BiuBiu工坊创建的个人访问令牌（PAT）。令牌仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，可随时在网站撤销。
description_en: Enter the Personal Access Token (PAT) created in BiuBiu Studio. It is stored locally under ~/.workbuddy only and can be revoked on the website at any time.
docLabel: 如何获取个人访问令牌？

fields.label: 个人访问令牌（PAT）
fields.description: 登录 semebiubiu.com → MCP 管理 → 创建令牌。完整生成需勾选 account:read、jobs:create、jobs:read、jobs:confirm、resources:read。
fields.description_en: Sign in at semebiubiu.com → MCP management → Create token. Full generation needs account:read, jobs:create, jobs:read, jobs:confirm and resources:read.
